These additions give concrete, short-video–friendly ideas for objection handling, pricing/negotiation roleplays, closing talk tracks, and microlearning quizzes suitable for B2B and B2C sales content.

BearingPoint launched GenAIQ, an enterprise agentic generative-AI platform designed to automate knowledge-intensive workflows, provide governance and integration for scaling generative AI across organizations; announced availability and product details in a Business Wire press release.

SEBI has reduced the minimum investment threshold for individual investors in Social Impact Funds from Rs 2 lakh to Rs 1,000 to increase retail participation on the Social Stock Exchange (SSE). Additionally, SEBI has reduced the minimum subscription requirement for zero coupon zero principal instruments from 75% to 50% and extended the registration validity for not-for-profit organizations to three years. Practical implications: This drastically lowers the entry barrier for retail investors to enter the social impact investing space and simplifies the operational requirements for NFPs seeking to use the SSE.

Meta announced Pixel and Conversions API updates (one-click Conversions API and AI-powered Pixel enhancements) to simplify tracking: a one-click, no-developer Conversions API setup and Pixel features that automatically add product/page details to events. Advertisers will receive a notice and have a 30-day review window before automatic enablement. Material impact: lowers engineering barriers for attribution and retargeting, improves event completeness for optimization and CRO, and is especially relevant to small Indian businesses setting up zero-to-one ad stacks.

ONEcount launched ONEcount Q, the media industry's first AI-powered natural language audience query tool, enabling publishers and media companies to query, filter, and segment subscriber data using plain-English questions or voice input.

Apartment operators are moving from broad cost cutting to data-driven cost discipline to protect NOI amid rising costs, with practical lessons that retention efforts can significantly reduce turnover costs and data-informed amenity auditing can prioritize high-ROI investments like smart locks and package lockers over underutilized spaces.

SEBI has significantly lowered the minimum investment amount for social impact funds to Rs 1,000, potentially increasing accessibility to impact investing for a wider range of investors and entrepreneurs.

Shadowfax, a Bengaluru-based logistics company, launched a new proprietary shipping platform called '360 Portal for SMEs' on April 21, 2026, designed to streamline shipping operations for small and medium enterprises. Funding Analysis (2026-07-06): Indian technology startups raised approximately $4.37 billion in disclosed funding during Q2 2026 (April-June). The funding landscape is described as 'barbell-shaped', with high activity at the seed and late stages while mid-stage funding remains thin. There is also a noted increase in the role of non-VC capital, such as private equity and debt instruments. Practical short-form video topic: 'The Barbell Effect: Why Mid-Stage Funding is Disappearing in India's 2026 Startup Scene'.

Regulatory and Macro Shifts (Q2 2026): Three key variables are currently shaping venture capital in India: SEBI's evolving Alternative Investment Fund (AIF) regulatory framework, a trend where seed-stage valuations are decoupling from actual revenue metrics, and the influence of US-China trade disruptions on international LP capital flows. Practical short-form video topics: 'How SEBI's New AIF Rules Change Your Fundraising Strategy' and 'The Valuation Gap: Seed Stage vs. Revenue in 2026'.

Under the SEBI (Stock Brokers) Regulations 2026, existing stock brokers must comply with the residency requirement—ensuring at least one designated director stays in India for 182 days or more—by July 7, 2026.

The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) issued a series of circulars in June 2026 focused on enhancing digital onboarding standards, implementing 100% wallet KYC, improving cybersecurity, and streamlining customer complaint governance.

Deelan updated its sales enablement resources page with five new practical guides and frameworks: 'How to Give Feedback to Sales Reps' (15 real examples), '8 Steps to Build a Winning Sales Playbook in 2026', 'Call Shadowing for Sales Teams', '5 Sales Meeting Agenda Templates', and 'Sales Territory Design: A Practical Guide With 7 Models'.
Figma integrated GPT-5.6, OpenAI's latest model, into Figma Make, allowing users to use the more capable model via the model picker in the chatbox.

Figma updated its AI image tools to allow users to run multiple AI image edits simultaneously in the background, improving design efficiency.
ONDC raised ₹220 crore in a funding round from Zoho, Uber, Paytm, and BSE to further its growth and digital commerce initiatives.

Google DeepMind released Gemini 3.5, focusing on frontier intelligence with action.

Meta has fully deployed 'Andromeda', a system where creative content now serves as the primary targeting signal rather than interest-based definitions. Other updates include the general availability of Threads ads (which show lower CPMs of ~$4.20 compared to FB Feed) and a lower stabilization threshold for Advantage+ Value Optimization (pLTV models can now stabilize with 30-50 high-value events per week).

Meta implemented several key changes in May 2026, most notably extending the maximum retention window for purchase-event custom audiences from 180 days to 730 days (effective May 18). This automatically expanded existing purchase audiences, potentially increasing retargeting pool sizes and widening exclusions. Additionally, a Meta AI business assistant was rolled out to all advertisers in Ads Manager to help triage account issues like CPA spikes.
Anthropic published a case study on July 9, 2026, detailing how UST is bringing Claude to physical AI applications.

Meta announced a new brand-aware AI creative ad ecosystem, a unified Creator Marketing Hub, and Business Agent updates at Cannes Lions 2026 to enable marketers to generate, test, and translate ads using AI.

The Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA), via General Circular No. 03/2026, extended the validity of the Companies Compliance Facilitation Scheme, 2026 (CCFS-2026) from July 15, 2026, to August 31, 2026, to assist companies with pending statutory filings.

The Indian stock market witnessed a recovery on July 1, 2026, with the NSE Nifty 50 climbing 140.10 points to settle at 24,005.85, reclaiming the psychologically important 24,000 mark, while the BSE Sensex closed at 76,922.64.

The RBI issued the (Rural Co-operative Banks – Governance) Amendment Directions, 2026, introducing a mandatory three-year cooling-off period for directors who have completed a continuous ten-year tenure before they can be re-appointed to the board of the same bank.

EU lawmakers agreed to revisions of the EU AI Act to reduce rule overlap, introduce new prohibitions, and extend deadlines for high-risk AI systems to facilitate easier business implementation.

This affects Search, Shopping, Performance Max, Demand Gen, Display, and Hotel campaigns, but excludes App, Video reach, and Video view campaigns.
